items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 June 2026 11:12am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 13 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure north of Scotland, with high pressure south of England gradually tracking northwards.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the east of the area, veering northwest this evening, then decreasing 3 or 4 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, becoming variable 2 to 4 tomorrow afternoon, settling east 3 or 4 occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, falling smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
